nom: PEACH & LILY Beam Blocker Invisible Sunscreen SPF 30

avis.texte: Does the job. Wonderful product. Don't go outside without it.
I have struggled my whole life to find a face sunscreen that doesn't burn my eyes (even when not applied near them) and may my skin super shiny/sticky. This one does the job!

Tried this a few times and I enjoy the finish. When comparing to my standby, the Supergoop unseen sunscreen, I like it equally though the formulas are different. This is more of a thin lotion style vs the gel of the supergoop. Little to no scent. This has no cast at all on my brown skin and rubs in easily. I didn't feel shiny or oily by end of day (I tend to get oily T zone). It also didn't pill over my other skincare, which I appreciate. My only critique would be the SPF is on the lower side for high end sunscreen. I prefer a higher SPF of 50 or over. 30 is fine for mixed indoor/outdoor days like going to work or running errands. Please come out with a higher SPF version for outdoor use (pool, party, etc. )! :)

As someone with rosacea and sensitive skin, I've been finding that a good sunscreen is so important. This one feels great! Lightweight, non irritating, gives a lovely glow and doesn't irritate my eyes which alot of sunscreens do.
This is a really nice formula! It doesn't leave a white cast and is so light on the skin. Love!

avis.titre: Blends in great with no w
avis.texte: Blends in great with no white cast. The formulation is thin so its easy to spread. Only issue is that its slightly greasy so I have not had great success layering foundation over it. Not a huge issue but something to consider.
I love the silky finish and it sinks in nicely. I've only used it a couple of times and I already really like its performance!
This is the first sunscreen I've ever used that doesn't feel like you're wearing sunscreen. It's so lightweight and leaves my face glowing!
This does not pill up on the skin and I have not had any irritation. No cast left on skin and it's hydrating

I really like this sunscreen! Not too heavy or oily. My skin likes it and doesn't break out. However, I feel like my face still gets red/burned with it. I will need to use another sunscreen adjacent if outside too long
Usually I use Centella or Anessa but given the tariffs, I've been running low. I decided to give this sunscreen a shot and I think it's pretty good.

I love this invisible sunscreen because sometimes, especially summer, I don't need a tinted one. I have only used it a few times so far but will be making it a part of my daily routine. I will also use the tinted version when I feel I need it, but mostly during the winter months.

I love this sunscreen! I've used this sunscreen on top of my Peach and Lily serum and moisturizer. I have combination skin and usually sunscreen causes my skin to feel greasy and shiny throughout the day especially if used on top of my other skin products. In the past I also had a filmy white residue left over from other sunscreens. I experienced none of this with my new sunscreen. The sunscreen itself if light and goes on smoothly. No oily skin and residue. I will definitely be continuing to use this and highly recommend

I have been using this sunscreen for over a week now and it does the job of protecting my skin from the sun and my skin definitely feels moisturized, but that is it. Unfortunately it does irritate my eyes when I am sweating a little which I noticed and can't stand honestly. Furthermore there is nothing added to this sunscreen as an added benefit that justifies the price point. It's too bad because I actually like Peach & Lily for other products I use. I'll finish my tube of sunscreen but I won't be buying it again.
Very thin white sunscreen, super smooth and makes skin looks beautiful. Wears well under makeup. Definitely a new favorite and long awaited product from this brand.
It feels lightweight and makes my skin glow! Its also very soft and does not have any white cast.

This sunscreen, unfortunately, made me break out. I developed a rash on my cheek after using it. I have sensitive skin, so I'd skip this one if you're prone to reactions. I switched to the mineral version and haven't had any issues so far. This was the only new product I added to my routine.
This SPF is glass skin in a bottle. Everytime i have it on strangers compliment my skin!
So silky! Love how this is so lightweight and feels like a moisturizer instead of a sunscreen. Works nicely under my makeup
I have been using this for a couple weeks now and I enjoy it. Its not greasy and I can wear under my make up. A trick for application is rubbing it into your hands then press/pat on the sunscreen.
Texture was fine, but definitely caused breakouts. Steer clear if you're acne prone!
bad orange color, not proper sun protection and caused breakouts
I love that it doesn't feel greasy and has ingredients that are good for skin.
I genuinely love this sunscreen, ive had no breakouts or issue with it under makeup. I wish it came in a higher spf!

I really love this SPF so far! The texture is so smooth, it feels good to apply and wear. I don't have oily skin but a lot of sunscreens I've tried make my skin feel greasy, this one does not. It has the very slightest typical sunscreen smell, but i like it and you really can't detect it unless you are trying to smell it from the bottle. Only downside is that it's not a higher SPF. But it is definitely something i actually want to put on, unlike most facial sunscreens
